newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BT confident get EU clearance for MCI deal.
newsitem.headline: BT confident get EU clearance for MCI deal.

text.p: British Telecommunications' head of EU affairs Larry Stone said on Monday he was optimistic the European Commission will clear its merger with U.S. second largest telecommunications company MCI.
Stone said he hoped the deal would be dealt with under the EU's fast-track merger rules and did not anticipate any anti-trust problems because the companies "operate in competitive markets".
BT confident get EU clearance for MCI =2
"One of the clearances we will be seeking is the European Commission's. We're confident that will be forthcoming," Stone told Reuters on the telephone.
BT and MCI announced they would merge their operations in their existing joint venture Concert in a $20 billion deal.
Stone said that the Commission was given "all the relevant press and public material" on the operation on Sunday. BT would also be talking with Commission officials "imminently".
He thought the deal would fall under the merger regulation which allows for EU clearance within a month of the deal being notified it does not pose competition concerns.
